values.title: Craft over shortcuts
values.description: We'd rather do fewer things exceptionally well than chase every trend. Every project gets the same level of care, whether it's a five-page website or a full brand relaunch.

values.title: Partnership over transactions
values.description: We work alongside our clients, not just for them. The best outcomes come from real collaboration, honest feedback, and staying involved long after the first deliverable ships.

values.title: Clarity over jargon
values.description: Good creative work should be easy to understand and easy to act on. We explain our thinking in plain language and keep every project transparent from kickoff to launch.

values.title: Results over vanity metrics
values.description: Beautiful work that doesn't move the needle isn't good work. We measure success by what it does for your business, not just how it looks in a portfolio.

founder.name: Praveen Guptha
founder.bio: Praveen Guptha founded MellowDigi with a simple belief: great design and dependable execution shouldn't be mutually exclusive. MellowDigi is a new studio, built from the ground up around brand strategy, digital production and technology — and Praveen stays hands-on with every project, working directly with clients from the first conversation through final delivery.

ourPromises.title: Direct Access, No Middlemen
ourPromises.text: You work with the person actually doing the work — usually the founder — not an account manager relaying messages back and forth.

ourPromises.title: Honest Timelines
ourPromises.text: We'd rather give you a realistic delivery date than a fast one we can't keep. What we promise is what you get.

ourPromises.title: Pricing That Fits Where You Are
ourPromises.text: Early-stage budgets get early-stage pricing, with room to scale as your needs — and ours — grow.

ourPromises.title: One Team, Every Discipline
ourPromises.text: Branding, web and marketing come from the same small team, so nothing gets lost between handoffs.

ourPromises.title: We Sweat the Details
ourPromises.text: Every project — big or small — gets the same level of attention, because it's our reputation on the line too.

ourPromises.title: Built Around Your Feedback
ourPromises.text: Short feedback loops mean you see progress early and often, not just a reveal at the very end.
